top_strength: Rep delivered both core promises (On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage Coverage with full $2,000 terms) clearly and completely during the estimate, and gathered comprehensive logistics details across both properties despite the customer's initial resistance to photo documentation.
coaching_note: Rep never asked the two-concerns question at the top of step 2, and when the customer declined the virtual walkthrough, should have confirmed the walkthrough scheduling as the clean next step rather than proceeding to full pricing on an 1,800 sq ft move — the call became a quasi-quote instead of a proper walkthrough-scheduler handoff.
